primary_source.title: What comes after AGI? From AGI to Superintelligence
primary_source.subtitle: As multiple technological routes toward artificial general superintelligence take shape, the regime beyond AGI is shifting from philosophical speculation to empirical research and governance questions.
primary_source.thesis: AGI 临近，后 AGI  regime 应从哲学思辨转向实证研究；从 AGI 到 ASI 有多条路径，它们复合叠加，须建模/测量/预测以追踪进展。
structure: The continuum of general intelligence（智能连续统：AGI 只是其中一点，ASI=在几乎所有人类关注任务上持续超越大量专家，用更少资源时间）
Cognitive industrialization（认知工业化：有效算力≈10x/年，成本≈4x/年下降，认知任务商品化）
Four pathways: Scaling models and data / Technological paradigm shifts / Improving agent coordination / Recursive self-improvement
The many roads to ASI（多路径复合，限制单一路径无效且会造成 capability overhang）

four_pathways.scaling: scaling laws 是观察趋势的外推，仅在熟悉边界内成立；瓶颈=数据枯竭/规模收益递减/物理经济资源限制
four_pathways.paradigm_shift: 今日模型缺 continual learning/world modeling/sample efficiency/发明新概念；研究者对能否靠渐进延伸達ASI 有分歧
four_pathways.coordination: 多智能体 scaling laws 尚缺；早期研究发现智能增益但协调低效致收益递减；需防 misinfo/manipulation/collusion
four_pathways.rsi: RSI 非单一过程：code/design（遗传）、data（文化，AlphaZero 例）、group specialization（社会）三种机制；反馈差则循环易 stall/degenerate；需在超人领域可扩展的评估，自动化验证领域（数学证明）最快

rsi_key_quotes: Whether RSI leads to 'runaway' progress is largely an empirical question.
RSI loops can easily stall or degenerate if the feedback guiding them is poor.
RSI should advance fastest in domains that allow for automated verification without humans in the loop, such as mathematical proofs, while other domains might lag behind or taper off sooner.

These three RSI mechanisms mirror evolutionary processes that drove the growth of human cognitive capabilities: genetic (code and design), cultural (data), and social evolution (group specialization through cooperation).

extrapolation_numbers.effective_compute: 硬件1.5x/年 × 算法效率3-6x/年 × 硬件投资2.5x/年 = 至少10x/年（算术核验：[11.25,22.5]自洽）
extrapolation_numbers.ten_year: 10^10 = 100亿倍（算术自洽）；称'每个今天agent可跑比世界人口还多'(10^10>8e9, 自洽)

honesty_signals: 明确区分'已知上界'与'上界之前大片未探明区域'
明确 scaling laws 'hold only within familiar boundaries'，不能自信预测 AGI/ASI 所需规模
明确数据'not all data produced by AI models is useful for training'
明确多智能体'coordination inefficiencies still lead to diminishing returns'
明确 RSI 'largely an empirical question'、'can easily stall or degenerate'
文末'None of these predictions are certain'
